# US outreach: batch 2 (test fixture: made-up universities and contacts)

Every student support e-mail shares the same middle block, marked **[COMMON BLOCK]** below. It is written out once here and goes into each e-mail unchanged:

> I'm based in Ankara, Turkey, and would work with you as an independent contractor. I can cover US hours, up to six days a week, at $15-20 an hour (happy to talk about what works for you).
>
> A quick bit about me:
> - 2 years on a Turkish Airlines customer service line, mostly in English, then handling escalated cases in the back office
> - CRM Specialist for a company with offices in Ankara and Camarillo, CA, working US hours (5 PM to 3 AM my time)
> - BA in American Culture and Literature (Hacettepe University), now studying Management Information Systems, and C2 English
> - A summer in the US in 2014 on a J-1 Work and Travel exchange
> - 4 years in software QA, if you ever need a hand with LMS or IT testing
>
> I've attached my résumé. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call?
>
> Thanks so much,
> Berk Kaldar
> Ankara, Turkey
> linkedin.com/in/berkaldar
